notes:
Snapshot: mid-market SaaS (product analytics / CSM knowledge layer). Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first for quick integration + baseline metrics, then moving to Dedicated if throughput/cost tradeoffs look good.

Key pain: high-volume nightly embedding pipeline + low-latency support search. They ingest large amounts of semi-structured product docs, ticket transcripts, and feature flags. Want single API for embeddings + generation to avoid stitching.

POC goals (customer):
- Validate embeddings throughput for nightly jobs (target ~250k docs per nightly run, typical doc length 300-800 tokens).
- Measure end-to-end indexing into Pinecone (they currently use Pinecone) with Redwood batching + backpressure handling.
- Realtime search SLAs: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 150ms under 150 concurrent users in support UI.
- Cost projection: want estimate for 6-12 month steady-state and committed monthly pricing for Dedicated.

Notes from calls:
- "We need predictable monthly bills — bursty usage kills our forecasting." — Head of Platform
- SE asked about VPC peering and private ingestion pipelines; infra wants KMS integration for embeddings at rest.
- Security reviewer: requires SOC2 + audit logs + 90d retention controls; Okta SSO mandatory.

Hosted API POC (Feb 2026):
- Demo run: 8 parallel workers embedding a sample of 100k docs -> observed embedding throughput ~850 embeddings/sec (sustained for 10m windows).
- Search latency (hosted): average query latency 45ms, p95 observed 120-140ms for the sample dataset (with Pinecone vector lookups).
- Bottleneck observed: ingestion step (HTTP queueing) when batching small files; Redwood Optimize suggestion to increase batch window to 300ms reduced overhead ~18%.

Dedicated interest:
- Wants dedicated pool sized for predictable nightly batches + steady real-time QPS. Interested in reserved capacity discounts and burst pools for campaign days.
- Ask: show a Dedicated sizing workbook (GPU hours per 250k-nightly, recommended autoscale policy, fallback model variant pricing).

Sales/Procurement notes:
- Pricing convo: mid-market ARR expectation 25k-100k depending on reserved commit. Customer asked for sample contract language on data residency.
- Legal flagged need for DPA and SCCs (EU customers, but HQ NA).

Next steps (short):
- Diego to send Dedicated sizing workbook + sample PO by 2026-03-05.
- Provision 30-day Dedicated POC env (scoped, limited data) once VPC peering approved.
- Run 2-week benchmark: nightly embedding run (250k docs) + simulated 150 concurrent UI queries.

Open items / blockers:
- Legal signoff on DPA + encryption clauses.
- Cloud networking (VPC peering) calendar — infra team prioritization required.
- Need more precise pricing for high-volume embedding (per-embedding discount tiers).

Internal hints for AE/SE:
- Emphasize Redwood Optimize batching recommendations and prefix/KV cache for chat-like searches.
- Offer a short benchmark plan and a template for ingest pipeline (S3 -> Redwood batch -> Pinecone).
- Low friction: start with Hosted API keys + Terraform snippets, then move to Dedicated sizing call.
